content:
PETREX GmbH is a dynamic and forward-thinking chemical company headquartered at Wachtendonker Straße 11, D-47906 Kempen, Germany—a strategically located industrial hub in the heart of the Rhineland. Founded with a strong commitment to innovation, sustainability, and customer-centric solutions, PETREX specializes in the development, formulation, and distribution of high-performance specialty chemicals for diverse industrial applications. Its portfolio encompasses advanced additives for polymers and coatings, functional surfactants, customized intermediates, and eco-conscious formulations aligned with EU REACH, CLP, and GHS regulatory frameworks.  

Operating from modern, ISO-certified facilities, PETREX combines decades of technical expertise with agile R&D capabilities to collaborate closely with clients across automotive, construction, electronics, packaging, and renewable energy sectors. The company places sustainability at its core—prioritizing green chemistry principles, energy-efficient production, recyclable packaging, and continuous reduction of VOC emissions and hazardous substances. PETREX maintains rigorous quality management systems and offers comprehensive technical support, including formulation assistance, regulatory documentation, and on-site application engineering.  

With a dedicated team of chemists, application specialists, and logistics experts—and strong partnerships across Europe and beyond—PETREX GmbH stands out for its responsiveness, reliability, and long-term orientation. Its Kempen location benefits from excellent transport links, enabling efficient pan-European delivery and fostering close proximity to key industrial clusters. As industries accelerate their transition toward circular and low-carbon operations, PETREX continues to evolve as a trusted innovation partner—delivering not just chemical products, but intelligent, future-ready solutions grounded in scientific excellence and ethical responsibility.
